control.already_running: a supervised run is already active
control.missing_target: this server governs no project, or its folder is gone — open the project from the launcher
control.cr_not_decidable: this change request cannot be decided right now
control.cycle_state: the spec-cycle state does not allow this — check the cycle status (open/closed) and retry the matching action

import.no_supported_files: none of these files are a supported document type
import.already_governed: This folder is already governed by Vivicy — importing here would overwrite it.
import.not_governed: this project is no longer governed by Vivicy — its .vivicy directory is missing
import.zip_slip: this .zip contains an unsafe path and was rejected

scaffold.not_a_directory: target path is not a directory

fsBrowse.unsafe: folder name does not resolve to a direct child
fsBrowse.exists: a file or folder with that name already exists here

layoutSave.no_target: this project's folder is gone — the layout was not saved; restore the folder and try again
layoutSave.invalid_payload: the layout save request is malformed
layoutSave.patch_failed: could not apply the layout patch
layoutSave.regen_failed: the map could not be regenerated

route.map_not_json: architecture map is not valid JSON
route.map_bad_shape: architecture map has an unexpected shape

projects.not_a_directory: that path is not a folder
projects.unknown_project: Vivicy does not know that project — open its folder again.
projects.registry_busy: another window is opening a project right now — try again in a moment
projects.no_free_port: every port Vivicy reserves for project servers is taken — stop a project first
projects.not_built: Vivicy has no production build yet — run npm run build, then open the project again.
projects.not_ready: the project's server never answered — check its log and try again
projects.spawn_failed: the project's server could not be started
